final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS value FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_count, AVG(rc.copy_count - ac.value) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc JOIN average_count AS ac ON ac.value IS NOT NULL WHERE rc.copy_count > ac.value
